_comment: Sample deploy-guard config. Copy to config.json and edit for your fork. The real config.json is gitignored (per-fork, contains your project list). All paths/projects below are placeholders.

review_models._comment: Optional. The complete reviewer list with exact model, minimum effort, and runner (agy|muse|codex|claude) is used only after approval by the instance approver. Otherwise code defaults apply. Changes to resolved review_models invalidate open-plan review receipts and judge verdicts.
